ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface consists of approximately 98% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with less than 2% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid dark-pigment field. Small, high-contrast white circular clusters are localized on the distal end of the right lobe and scattered near the right-side trailing edge. A single small, thin white ring-shaped blob is visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; the vertex is sharply defined with an estimated angle of 40 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical topography. The left lobe trailing edge features small, frequent, low-amplitude serrations. The right lobe trailing edge features extreme, high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep, irregular rectangular-shaped voids/notches, significantly departing from a linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a standard convex sweep. The right lobe sweep is severely truncated and irregular due to significant missing sections along the trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small white circular clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) on the right lobe, particularly concentrated toward the tip and the traumatic edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, oriented primarily on a diagonal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe physical trauma/tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge, resulting in a series of deep, jagged, and stepped indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe displays a distinctive 'notched' or 'bitten' appearance that is highly atypical for standard fluke morphology.
